messages.author: Sepideh Jafari
messages.body:
Dear Amber users,
I already have Ubuntu 22 and want to install Amber 20 or 22 on GPU.
(CPU successful)
but the Cuda is the problem.
I deleted all of these commands and installed Cuda 11.
sudo apt-get purge nvidia* sudo apt remove nvidia-*
sudo rm /etc/apt/sources.list.d/cuda*
sudo apt-get autoremove && sudo apt-get autoclean
sudo rm -rf /usr/local/cuda*
but still, it is written the Cuda is 12 on my system detected.
I don't know what I should do.
Here <
https://gist.github.com/primus852/b6bac167509e6f352efb8a462dcf1854
>,
there is the link I used.
Would you please help me with this?
Thank you so much
Kind regards
Sepideh Jafari
